version_statement: Changed in version 3.11: Added the 'z' option.
interpretation: The standard grammar supports zero coercion beginning with Python3.11. Type-specific custom __format__ implementations define their own specification semantics, while explicit s/r/a conversions format the converted builtin value. This is specification evidence; no CPython3.11 interpreter execution is claimed.
corroboration: Actual separately labeled CPython3.10.19 and3.14 controls reject and accept z.2f respectively; Unicode and custom-protocol exactsource controls executed3.10.19.
